title: galium ciliatum var. normale
intro: Galium ciliatum var. normale, commonly known as Prairie Bedstraw, is a plant species belonging to the family Rubiaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include the treatment of fever, cough, and respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Prairie Bedstraw are attributed to its ability to stimulate sweating, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activity, making it a useful remedy for skin conditions and wounds. The bioactive constituents of Prairie Bedstraw include alkaloids, phenolic compounds, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
